name: gateway_run_adapter_credential_fingerprint
notes: Salted credential fingerprint sha256('hermes-mux:'+token).hexdigest()[:16]. Harness is a faithful traced copy of run_pure2.c::gw_adapter_credential_fingerprint; SHA-256 is embedded in the harness because lib/libhash/hash.c needs OpenSSL at link time and wc_run's flag ordering places -l flags before objects. Twin drives LIVE GatewayRunner._adapter_credential_fingerprint on a duck-typed adapter (.token attr); 'null' encodes the no-credential -> None path. Whitespace-stripping and empty-after-strip branches covered.
